subject: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda

Team —

Thanks for agreeing to join the banding micro-calibration session tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Goal is narrow: resolve 8 cross-team outliers where anchor raters diverge by 2+ bands, and to confirm any immediate promotion queue adjustments that require people-ops coordination.

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick framing: evidence vs. signal (5m)
- Walk 8 outlier cases (20m) — each case: summary, anchor rationale, evidence packet
- Decisions & follow-ups (5m)

Prep ask: please upload any case-level evidence into the shared Drive folder and add one-line recommended band adjustment (no more than +1 / -1) by EOD today. I attached a short agenda and there's an evidence CSV template in the Drive.

Attachments: agenda_calibration_2027-06-20.pdf

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda

Sounds good — I'll be there. Quick heads-up: Case #3 (Eng Lead candidate on Cloud Infra) has new peer survey comments that I just uploaded; those push me to recommend +1 rather than hold. Please review the "peer_highlights" column in the CSV before we walk it.

Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:08:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda

Uploaded: evidence_packet_nimbus.csv to Drive (link below). I pre-marked my recommended adjustments in the "recommended_shift" column and added a short rationale row-by-row. Quick summary:
- Cases 1, 2: majority of objective OKR evidence supports current band (no change).
- Case 3: agree with Lauren, peer comments + product impact suggest +1.
- Case 6: anchor rater used limited sample of Q1 deliverables; after reviewing logs I lean -1.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-evidence-packet
Attachment: evidence_packet_nimbus.csv

If we confirm any +1 into the promotion window today, we need Naomi/People Ops looped for timing.

Vivek
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda

Thanks for the heads-up. If the group moves any case into the promotion queue (i.e., +1 confirmed), People Ops needs: final signed manager note, promotion packet, and a target effective date. Also flag any changes that should be withheld from public rollouts for confidentiality.

For the outlier cases where there is disagreement >1 band, People Ops prefers we create an appeal buffer: a 2-week review window during which the candidate stays in current band pending an appeal or additional evidence. If you anticipate a lot of immediate promotions, let me know and I can pre-open the promotion workflow in Workday.

cc: Karthik — please confirm whether you'd like People Ops to hold promotions until after the July compensation cycle.

Naomi Feldman
Head of People Operations (external partner coordination)
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence-led banding reconciliation and micro-calibration agenda — notes & actions

Team — thanks for the quick sync and pragmatic decisions. Notes and action items below (also saved in the Drive as calibration_notes_2027-06-20.txt).

Decisions (agreed by all present):
- Case 1: no change.
- Case 2: no change.
- Case 3 (Cloud Infra Eng Lead): confirmed +1 into promotion queue; manager note and packet to Naomi by EOD Wed (2027-06-23).
- Case 6: confirmed -1; manager to add remediation plan to 1:1 notes.
- Remaining outliers: held in appeal buffer for 2 weeks pending additional evidence.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Lauren: finalize manager note and upload to Drive (due 2027-06-23).
- Vivek: add technical evidence summary (logs + release impact) to CSV (done).
- Naomi: pre-open promotion workflow for Case 3 and hold promotions until Karthik confirms timing (expected reply by Tue EOD).
- Karthik: confirm whether promotions should wait for July comp (reply by 2027-06-22).

HR coordination: Naomi — please attach the promotion packet link to the Jira HS-PR-2027-06-20 and confirm what confidential flags we need when notifying managers.

Attachments: calibration_notes_2027-06-20.txt (summary + action items)

Forwarded for record: On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 16:10 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote: "If the group moves any case into the promotion queue..."

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
